* screenshot thumbnail ... # Deadly Boss Mods ## Getting too many updates of DBM per day? Multiple alpha versions can get pushed to Curse/Wago on an average day, these versions may contain important new features or bug fixes for the bleeding edge raid content… These versions are tagged as alpha, so they will not be downloaded by default. Set your addon client to update to alpha if you want these latest versions (but they may contain bugs, downloads tagged as "Beta" or "Release" are more stable and released less frequently) Right click on DBM itself in addon client list and set to preferred release type to control update frequency. ## Features * Mods for raid, dungeon, special event and Brawlers Guild * Super efficient: average of 0.24% CPU usage during raid boss fights with all features enabled! * Colored raid warnings (players will be colored according to their class) with icons and to the point messaging.

# Gargul
image
The all-in-one loot addon for World of Warcraft. GDKP, SoftRes, auto looting, auto rolling, TMB, DFT, and more. Works on Retail, Classic Era, and every flavor in between.
Only the loot master needs Gargul for most features. Raiders benefit from installing it too, but it's not required.

...

## What Can It Do?
| Feature | What it does | Command |
| **GDKP** | Auction loot and split the gold. Multi-auction lets you sell many items at once. | `/gdkp` or `/gl ma` |
| **Auto Looting** | Automatically send loot to the right player. Greens to DE, epics to ML, you name it. | `/gl pm` |
